This week, for the first time, America intervened in its own bond market.

Yields were climbing past 5.5%. Too much debt being issued, not enough buyers to absorb it.
So they bought their own debt to keep yields under 6%.

Why 6%? Because above that line, the cost of borrowing and interest payments becomes crushing, and the whole system tips into a death spiral.

Buying your own debt to cap yields has a name: yield curve control. It has now officially begun.
The signal to the world is unmistakable: America will provide liquidity. It will choose inflation over a natural market correction.

What happens next is predictable. Monetary expansion speeds up, and the rate of currency debasement accelerates, hard.

The current pace is already brutal. Purchasing power halves roughly every 10 years. $10,000 today buys what $5,000 bought in 2016. You’ve seen it in house prices. You’ve seen it on restaurant menus.

That was the slow, stealthy version. The next phase is fast. Expect severe inflation and purchasing power halving in 5 years, not 10.

So own hard assets. Build a business that generates cash flow. Hold some stocks and commodities.

Buy gold, silver, Bitcoin, Monero, stocks, memecoins, and businesses that earn income,  and hold assets.

Keep only 1–3 years of expenses in savings. Convert the rest into hard assets.

Savers will be robbed. They just won’t realise it until five years from now, when they see how little their money still buys.

Time is running out.

The bar for outperforming the rate of currency debasement, year after year has risen.

Take care and prepare accordingly.

text:
@BitcoinWifey @ForrestHODL Great point Joyce. 
Also wanna point out that using a preassembled, purpose-built Bitcoin hardware wallet IS indeed introducing counterparty risk to one’s setup, insofar as it can’t be built with generic hardware or disassembled by the user

The US Treasury just said it will at least double the size of its long-end “liquidity support” buybacks. Ten-to-twenty and twenty-to-thirty year paper. Two billion max per operation becomes at least four.

It starts 9 September. It runs through 4 November. Then they will “provide more information” at the next Quarterly Refunding. That is the official wording. They have clearly put a date on the first step. They have not put a date on the last one.

What matters more is why they are doing it now. The long end was sending a message. Structural deficits. National Debt is about to hit $40 trillion. Interest costs ccontinue to worsen the higher the long rate goes. You cannot keep funding that at six percent on the 30-year and pretend the arithmetic still works... 

So what do they do? They do not announce printing. Instead, they buy their own duration in the background. They call it just 'plumbing'

This is not a press conference titled QE. It is much more hidden. It is operations. Bigger sizes. A window from September into November. Then another announcement. Repeat.

In my opinion that is pretty clear. They are going to keep intervening. If the long end stays disorderly, the “update” in November is not a wind-down. It is the next size.

The size of each operation is still a drop in the ocean. About $31.5 trillion of marketable Treasuries. About $5.5 trillion of longer-dated bonds. Four billion is roughly 0.013% of the market, or 0.07% of the long-bond stock. On the numbers alone, it should barely register.

It is the signalling that matters.

Look at what actually moved. Long yields fell on the headline. Gold popped. Bitcoin broke through recent resistance and is up about six percent, now retesting the 200-day moving average. Safe-haven assets did not react to 0.07% of the long-bond universe. They reacted to the shift: the issuer is now a larger, more active buyer of its own long paper, with another review already booked for November.

The key for any investor here is to watch the actions, not the language.

The US still leads. Other countries with the same problem will take notes. That is Europe. That is the UK. Same deficits. Same ageing. Same buyer fatigue at the long end. Debt interest still a political event every month.

If Washington shows you can lean on the long end without saying the Q-word, others will copy the template. They always do.

The political system will call this market support. That does not mean the cost of capital is being set freely.

The currency that funds that system can be expanded. Bitcoin cannot. It is capped at 21 million.

The Fed can expand the supply of dollars. The Treasury can double buybacks from September to November and take the sting out of the long bond. Neither can print more Bitcoin. Fixed supply. Twenty-one million. 

The network keeps producing a block every ten minutes whether the gilt market is orderly or not. 

That finality and certainty is why we treat Bitcoin $BTC as Digital Capital at Smarter Web. A Treasury announcement does not change the strategy. We keep growing our operating business, we keep adding Bitcoin to the treasury, and we keep increasing Bitcoin per share.

暗号資産関連株が上昇加速、Trump氏とBitcoinが二重の追い風
2026年8月19日 12:25 ET
By: Sara Sethiya, SA News Editor
https://t.co/gHOQEsdtke

水曜日、暗号資産関連株が上昇しました。投資家がBitcoin（BTC-USD）の直近の急騰だけでなく、米国の暗号資産規制の明確化に向けた重要な一歩となる可能性がある、Donald Trump大統領と暗号資産関連企業の経営幹部および主要な連邦規制当局者とのホワイトハウスでの会談に注目したためです。

Strategy（MSTR）は約12%上昇し、約$103.41となりました。Coinbase Global（COIN）はほぼ10%急騰し、約$160.34となりました。Circle Internet Group（CRCL）は約12%上昇して約$79.92、Robinhood Markets（HOOD）は約6%上昇して約$96.62となりました。
暗号資産関連株全体の上昇も同様に力強いものでした。Galaxy Digital（GLXY）は約6%上昇して約$21.60となった一方、CleanSpark（CLSK）は約2%上昇して約$11.96となりました。

MARA Holdings（MARA）は約7%上昇して約$9.75となりました。Bitmine Immersion Technologies（BMNR）とBullish（BLSH）もそれぞれ約13%急騰し、終値はそれぞれ約$20.61、約$27.89となりました。

今回の上昇の中心となったのはBitcoinです。Bitcoinは約$68.73Kで取引され、過去24時間で6%、過去1週間で8%上昇しました。

📷Bitcoin weekly price chart (TradingView)
Bitcoinの週足チャートは、約$65Kの水準を上抜けたことで強い上昇基調へと転じています。取引高が大幅に増加し、MACDも急速に上昇しており、買いモメンタムの強まりを示しています。ただし、RSIは92.63と極めて買われ過ぎの水準にあり、いったん上昇が一服したり、押し目を形成したりしても不思議ではありません。

こうしたテクニカル面の強さを背景に、ワシントンでは暗号資産規制が再び焦点となっています。Trump氏はホワイトハウスで、暗号資産関連企業のCEO、SECのPaul Atkins委員長、CFTCのMike Selig委員長と会談しています。協議の中心は規制の明確化ですが、CLARITY法は依然として停滞しています。Trump氏は、上院が9月15日に同法案を採決すると述べています。

規制環境も今週、改善しました。8月18日、SECは「Regulation Crypto Assets」を提案しました。これには、一定の暗号資産関連投資契約について、4年間で最大$5M、または12カ月間で$75Mを調達できる免除規定に加え、条件付きのセーフハーバーや、より明確な枠組みの構築を目指すその他の措置が含まれています。

規制強化の動きとBitcoinの上放れが相まって、暗号資産関連株には強力な上昇材料がもたらされています。ただし、BTCはすでに深刻な買われ過ぎの状態にあるため、次の動きは、上放れがすぐに反転するのではなく、その水準を維持できるかどうかに左右される可能性があります。

text:
A message from the founders:

Three years ago, something special happened on Bitcoin. The Ordinals protocol made it possible to create and trade digital assets with the permanence of storing data truly on-chain.

About 1 month after Ordinals went live, we launched OrdinalsBot as the first-ever inscription service on Bitcoin. We have been here since the start.

In these 3 years, we have achieved many great things and met amazing, like-minded people looking to bring new use cases to the mother chain and create a robust fee market.

Some things of note include helping countless people inscribe art and data on Bitcoin for the first time. The first BRC-20 token, ORDI, launched on our platform. We flawlessly deployed the Runestones airdrop, the largest (at the time) airdrop on Bitcoin to 112k addresses. We tokenized the Project Spartacus movement for Julian Assange, music for Ghostface Killah, art metadata for Michelangelo sculptures, and many more. We shipped rare sats tooling, a marketplace, and an ordinals launchpad. We were the main users of Mara's Slipstream service and inscribed most of the largest files on Bitcoin through them.

We are proud of what we built and would like to take this time to thank all of the people who built it with us.

That brings us to today. Unfortunately, the Ordinals market has contracted sharply over the past year. We tried everything from restructuring to pivoting, but sustaining the business is no longer viable.

We have, however, had interest in acquiring the OrdinalsBot brand, IP and assets. So, rather than let things drift, we have made the tough decision to wind down the company and put the full asset stack up for sale through an open, competitive process.

This includes the already established brand, all IP, domains, social accounts, Discord, GitHub, and 3+ years of R&D across over 90 code repositories. For any team looking to build on Bitcoin, acquiring this fully established infrastructure provides an immediate, battle-tested head start, potentially saving years of development from scratch.

We have already updated investors and have started receiving bids. If you are interested, or know someone who is, you can DM this account for the full information on how to bid.

Please be careful of anyone contacting you about this process. The only official contacts are @tobynovum and @bruffstar. If in doubt, DM them directly.

We will share more updates on this transition process as it unfolds. 

Thank you again to our incredible community and users for building the future of Bitcoin with us.

After the large wick and rejection, I entered my short at the 0.75 Fibonacci retracement.

With today's move, Bitcoin reached and briefly traded above the 200-Day MA, but we're currently back below it.

As I've mentioned before, the 200-Week MA is rising while the 200-Day MA is falling, creating a compression zone.

But I didn't expect price to get here this quickly, but the market doesn't care about expectations. It does what it wants, and our job is simply to adapt to the information it gives us.

On the lower timeframes, we've also started building liquidity both above and below the current range after roughly 90 minutes of consolidation. I'll be taking partial profits on the way down because nothing is ever truly overbought or oversold. Even after a move like today's, price can absolutely continue higher.

If we do sweep the liquidity above, I'll reassess in real time. Depending on the reaction, I may even add to my short. If the market proves me wrong, I'll simply adjust.

As always, this is based on my entry, my account size, and my risk management. Everyone's situation is different, so don't copy trades blindly.

For now, I'll continue managing the position, take profits where I think it makes sense, and keep everyone updated as new information comes in.
